ideas.about.hint: Who you are, what you do, who you serve, where.
ideas.offerings.hint: If you sell to customers: items and prices or how you quote.
ideas.faq.hint: What customers often ask and the answers you want used.
ideas.hours_location.hint: Opening hours, days off, address, how to reach you.
ideas.who_handles.hint: Who takes which kind of handoff and how to reach them.
ideas.qualification.hint: Criteria for good-fit leads and leads to drop.
ideas.approval_process.hint: What you approve, from what amount, and who covers for you.
ideas.payment_methods.hint: Receiving account, transfer reference, usual payment terms.
ideas.booking_services.hint: One line per service: name, duration, price. E.g. Men’s haircut, 45 min, 150,000đ; Colour, 120 min, from 600,000đ.
ideas.booking_cancellation.hint: When a deposit is due and how much, what late cancellation costs, how many reschedules. E.g. 30% deposit above 500,000đ; refunded if cancelled 24h ahead.
ideas.booking_resources.topic: Staff, rooms and equipment that can be booked
ideas.booking_resources.hint: Who or what takes bookings, which services each can do, max parallel guests, buffer between slots. E.g. Lan does nails and lashes; room 2 massage only; 10 min buffer.
ideas.booking_exceptions.topic: Booking hours, days off and exceptions
ideas.booking_exceptions.hint: Regular booking hours, holidays closed or changed, days staff are away. E.g. Mon-Sat 9:00-20:00; closed 30 Apr and 1 May.
ideas.loyalty_points.hint: How much spend earns how many points, multipliers, daily or per-order caps. E.g. 10,000đ = 1 point; double on birthdays; no points on voucher orders.
ideas.loyalty_rewards.hint: One line per reward: name, points, conditions, stock. E.g. Free drink, 100 points; 50,000đ voucher, 250 points, valid 30 days.
ideas.loyalty_tiers.hint: Tier names, how to reach and keep each, perks per tier. E.g. Silver from 0; Gold from 2,000 points a year, 5% off, priority booking.
ideas.loyalty_expiry.hint: When points expire, how members are warned, when points are removed. E.g. expire after 12 months idle; refunded orders reverse earned points.
ideas.hiring_roles.hint: Per role: main duties, must-have and nice-to-have, place, type. E.g. Cashier, full time, District 1, POS skills, F&B experience a plus.
ideas.hiring_process.hint: Each stage, who runs it, how long, pass criteria. E.g. CV screen (2 days), phone screen, manager interview, trial shift, offer within 3 days.
ideas.hiring_benefits.hint: What candidates can be told: bonus, insurance, leave, training, probation. E.g. 2-month probation at 85%; insurance after probation; 13th-month bonus.
ideas.hiring_salary_bands.hint: Pay band per role and the negotiation ceiling. Internal only, never shared with candidates or customers; keep it Restricted in the Brain. E.g. Cashier 7-9M.
ideas.content_pillars.hint: 3-5 fixed themes, share of each, target audience. E.g. Tips (40%), Behind the scenes (20%), Customer stories (20%), Offers (20%); aimed at mums 25-35.
ideas.content_banned_claims.hint: Words and promises not allowed, competitors not to name, industry rules. E.g. never ’cures’, ’number 1’, ’100% guaranteed’; no brand comparisons.
ideas.content_offers_calendar.hint: Upcoming offers, holidays and events by date with conditions. E.g. 20 Oct 15% off; 11 Nov buy 2 get 1; second branch opens 1 Dec.
ideas.content_channels_cadence.hint: Where to post, posts per week, times, what needs your approval. E.g. Facebook 4 a week at 19:00; TikTok 2 videos; posts with prices need approval.
ideas.video_brand_kit.hint: Logo, main colours, fonts, music dos and don’ts, aspect ratios. E.g. colour #0F766E; logo bottom right; vertical 9:16 under 30s.
ideas.video_offers.hint: Products or offers to push, their dates, the call to action. E.g. afternoon tea combo 99,000đ until 31 Oct; CTA: message us on Zalo to book.
ideas.video_claims.hint: What a video must not promise, banned imagery, who approves before posting. E.g. no weight-loss promises, no customer photos without consent; owner approves every video.
ideas.lead_icp.hint: Who is worth pursuing: age, job, area, budget, the problem they have. E.g. owners of 1-3 cafés in HCMC, budget 5-20M a month.
ideas.lead_questions.hint: A few ordered questions to understand need, one at a time. E.g. Which service? Rough budget? Needed by when? Best number to call?
ideas.lead_scoring.hint: Signals for each level and the next step. E.g. Hot = leaves a number and asks price or dates, call within 15 min; Warm = interested, no budget yet, follow up in a day; Cold = browsing, nurture.
ideas.lead_objections.hint: Common pushbacks and the reply you want. E.g. ’Too expensive’: explain value, offer a smaller package; ’Let me think’: agree a day to follow up.
ideas.lead_offers.hint: Prices and offers that may be shared openly, with dates and conditions. E.g. starter pack 2,990,000đ; 10% off for the first 20 customers in October; free consultation.
ideas.lead_forbidden_claims.hint: Promises, comparisons and results never to state to prospects. E.g. no promised revenue growth; no unpublished prices; no knocking competitors.
ideas.lead_routing.topic: Working hours and who receives leads
ideas.lead_routing.hint: Call-back hours, who gets hot leads, what happens out of hours. E.g. Huong takes leads 8-18h; after 18h promise a call at 8am; hot leads ping the owner on Zalo.
ideas.brand_voice.hint: A few sample replies you like.
